decision.revisit_condition: Reopen for the batch only, if a split of the investigation, run on a fresh batch task set (at least two batches of five unrelated issues, each with its own known answers, three sweeps, B = 250,000 per issue, the same model and checks), passes at least as many issues as one agent given the split's actual spend (arm S-plus, --match split), and the batch's wall-clock is a requirement: the batch must finish within a stated time that one agent's sequential run (here 34.9 s mean) misses and the split's (here 9.8 s) meets. On a single issue, reopen only if a split beats arm S-plus at the same spend by more than its sweep-to-sweep spread (here one pass of 18).
